change.mechanism: Assign rows in adjacent pairs with row = (localPair * blockCount + blockIdx) * 2 + pairOffset; each block receives a contiguous range of local pairs, while the global row pairs are striped across blocks.
change.hypothesis: Pair-stripe ownership keeps each two-row unit adjacent while spreading successive row pairs across blocks. It differs from R058 single-row stride ownership and R059/R060 contiguous per-block rows; active block count remains unchanged from R060.
